title: Protocolo de Extração de Biomassa de Coleções
author: Ricardo M. Borges

steps.title: Prepare biomass and extraction solution
steps.instruction: Process the dry plant material and prepare the solvent.

substeps.instruction: Grind all dry plant material using a coffee grinder until a homogeneous powder is obtained.
Weigh and separate 10 grams of powder for extraction into TWO 50 mL Falcon tubes (5 grams per tube).
Store the remaining ground material in Falcon tubes.
Prepare 600 mL of extraction solution (70% Ethanol).
Note: Process in batches of 6 samples (6 pairs of 50 mL Falcon tubes).

steps.title: Perform first extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the first fraction of the biomass.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL of extraction solution to each pair of tubes containing 5 g of plant material.
Agitate using a vortex for 15 seconds.
Subject to ultrasonication for 15 minutes in an ultrasonic bath.

steps.title: Centrifuge first extraction
steps.instruction: Separate the first supernatant from the biomass.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 RPM for 10 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Collect first supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the first supernatant into labeled glass screw-cap tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 4 x 5 mL of the supernatant into four previously labeled glass screw-cap tubes.
Repeat the transfer of 4 x 5 mL of supernatant into the four glass tubes, totaling 10 mL of supernatant removed per tube.
Ensure each sample (each pair of 5g) produces 4 identical aliquots.
Note: One of the four glass tubes per group must be tared for mass balance.

steps.title: Perform second extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the second fraction from the previously used biomass.

substeps.instruction: Add another 25 mL of extraction solution to the pairs of tubes already extracted.
Agitate using a vortex for 15 seconds.
Subject to ultrasonication for 15 minutes in an ultrasonic bath.

steps.title: Centrifuge second extraction
steps.instruction: Separate the second supernatant from the biomass.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 RPM for 10 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Collect second supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the second supernatant into labeled glass screw-cap tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 4 x 5 mL of the supernatant into the four previously labeled glass screw-cap tubes.
Repeat the transfer of 4 x 5 mL of supernatant into the four glass tubes.
Ensure each sample (each pair of 5g) produces 4 identical aliquots.

steps.title: Reserve aliquot for analysis
steps.instruction: Set aside a small volume of the final extract for analytical testing.

substeps.instruction: Separate 500 µL of the final extract from one of the four glass screw-cap tubes (the one NOT tared) into a clean, labeled glass vial for analyses such as LC-MS, NMR, or LC-DAD.

steps.title: Evaporate extracts
steps.instruction: Remove solvent from the extracts using a vacuum concentrator.

substeps.instruction: Evaporate all extracts in the carbonized glass tubes to dryness using a SpeedVac (GENIVAC) using the 'aqueous' method.
Note: GENIVAC limit is 24 pairs of glass screw-cap tubes.

steps.title: Recover dry extract
steps.instruction: Transfer and weigh the dried material.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the dry extract to Eppendorf tubes.
Record the weight for reference.

steps.title: Solubilize and purify extract
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the dry extract and remove particles.

substeps.instruction: Solubilize the dry content of the glass tubes for each extract in Methanol-Water (2:1).
Transfer the content to a 2 mL microtube.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13,000 RPM.
Collect the clear supernatant and transfer it to a new centrifuge tube.
Evaporate the content and store the particle-free extract for use.
